visualCharacteristics.purpose: Embed external interactive content or video in a responsive iframe
visualCharacteristics.description: Centered, responsive 16:9 iframe (max ~1000px wide) with an accessible title, lazy-created when the block nears the viewport, allowfullscreen. Genially (view.genially.com / view.genial.ly) and generic URLs load as is; YouTube, Vimeo and Vidyard page URLs are converted to their player URLs.

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = URL (link or plain text); row 2 = optional title (plain text, used as the iframe title; defaults to the link text or 'Embedded content').

usage.description: DxA 5000 Fit product page: Genially interactive feature image in the 'Explore DxA 5000 Fit Features' section.

reuseGuidance: Use for third-party iframe content (Genially, YouTube, Vimeo, Vidyard). Use columns or cards-grid video for a Vidyard video with a poster that plays on click inside a layout.
